goal: Extract cohesive test-step naming and location formatting responsibilities from TeamCityPlugin to reduce general methods and simplify event handling.

ops.details: Extract the cohesive step naming and location logic represented by ANNOTATION_GLUE_CODE_LOCATION_PATTERN, LAMBDA_GLUE_CODE_LOCATION_PATTERN, extractLocation(TestStepStarted), javaTestLocationUri(), formatHookStepLocation(HookTestStep,BiFunction<String,String,String>,Function<HookTestStep,String>), getHookName(HookTestStep), extractName(TestStep), and hookNameFormat(HookTestStep) into TeamCityStepFormatter. Preserve the existing handling of PickleStepTestStep, HookTestStep, HookType, Java annotation locations, and Java 8 lambda locations.

Update printTestStepStarted and printTestStepFinished to delegate step name and location calculation to TeamCityStepFormatter. Remove the duplicated private step-formatting methods and regular expression fields from TeamCityPlugin after all references are updated.
